reference.comparison_policy: Official documentation is scope evidence only. A status of live_characterized requires a dated authenticated observation artifact for every referenced profile, and differential_passed additionally requires an executable differential result. No such live comparison is claimed by this baseline.

delivery_phases.title: 기준선·검증
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Taxonomy coverage, baseline profiles, evidence redaction, deterministic characterization and differential harness contracts, legal review, and all Second Brain hard gates validate without overclaiming live parity.

delivery_phases.title: 런타임·호환
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Runtime, route, authentication, storage capability, transaction, idempotency, stable error, legacy compatibility, atomic-save, and Second Brain regression contracts pass without touching live stores.

delivery_phases.title: Workspace·IAM
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Workspace shell, page tree lifecycle, members, guests, groups, teamspaces, inheritance, destructive actions, and role capability matrices pass without permission leakage.

delivery_phases.title: Document·Editor
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Document schema, block round-trip, rich text, IME, selection, clipboard, undo, drag, autosave, conflict, history, focus, accessibility, and Second Brain publication snapshot scenarios pass.

delivery_phases.title: Database
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Canonical data sources, schema and property matrices, row pages, linked databases, saved views, personal/shared settings, formulas, relations, rollups, peek modes, and scale gates pass.

delivery_phases.title: Realtime·협업
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Two-client presence, operation ordering, convergence, reconnect, permission changes, comments, inbox, notifications, and suggested edits pass deterministic fault and recovery tests.

delivery_phases.title: 탐색·업무
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Workspace and database search, quick find, recents, backlinks, mentions, reminders, templates, buttons, wiki, feed, dashboards, charts, maps, layouts, print, and moving-workflow tracks pass permission and freshness gates.

delivery_phases.title: Forms·Sharing·Sites
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Database-backed forms, sharing permissions, public links and subtrees, publish lifecycle, Sites navigation, SEO, domain, analytics, files, and embeds pass anonymous and leakage matrices.

delivery_phases.title: Mobile·Offline
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Responsive web, iOS and Android navigation, touch, virtual keyboard, mobile inbox, device integrations, offline downloads, cache limits, queue, rebase, and conflict UI pass device and recovery matrices.

delivery_phases.title: 자동화·연결
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Automation triggers and actions, webhooks, OAuth lifecycle, external connections, sync databases, MCP, CLI and Workers moving tracks pass idempotency, replay, sandbox, privacy, and provider contract gates.

delivery_phases.title: AI·Agents·Enterprise
delivery_phases.exit_gate: AI and Agent permission, citation, action, refusal, meeting artifact, red-team, retention, enterprise role, audit, security, privacy, and moving-beta gates have reviewable evidence.

delivery_phases.title: 이관·Pilot·최종
delivery_phases.exit_gate: Approved migrations, backup and restore drills, reconciliation, canary and pilot soak, rollback, support, telemetry, performance, accessibility, security, legal, full differential, and Second Brain regression reports pass.

features.title: Atomic page metadata and block save with revision CAS and idempotent operation identity
features.notes: This verifies only the local save contract and failure safety. It is not a live Notion characterization or differential pass.

features.title: Block insertion, conversion, selection, nesting, drag, clipboard, rich text, IME, and undo transactions
features.notes: The current block catalog and editor entry points exist; exact IME, selection, and browser behavior has not been characterized.

features.title: Identical editing semantics in main, side peek, center peek, and full-page surfaces
features.notes: Main and side-peek renderers currently differ; this row records the required convergence without claiming parity.

features.title: Suggested edits with review, accept, reject, attribution, and notification behavior
features.notes: Deferred until the shared transaction and realtime layers exist; no implemented behavior is claimed.

features.title: Workspace sections, page tree, favorites, teamspaces, shared/private navigation, sorting, pinning, and drag nesting
features.notes: Basic recent, shared, private, favorite, tree, and drag surfaces exist; live ordering and section behavior is uncharacterized.

features.title: Workspace search, database search, page find, filters, relevance, exact phrases, previews, and keyboard navigation
features.notes: Search entry points exist; query semantics and permission-sensitive indexing have not been differentially tested.

features.title: Canonical data sources, view tabs, table, board, timeline, calendar, list, gallery, chart, form, feed, map, dashboard, properties, formulas, relations, and rollups
features.notes: Multiple local renderers exist, but rows, views, and properties remain embedded in block props and are not a characterized canonical data-source model.

features.title: Page, block, and database comments, replies, reactions, resolve/reopen, mentions, reminders, inbox grouping, read/archive, and notification actions
features.notes: CRUD surfaces exist. Realtime delivery, server read/archive state, suggestions, grouping, and action parity are not characterized.

features.title: Share versus Publish separation, public links, expiry, subpage inheritance, Sites navigation, theme, SEO, domain, embeds, duplication, and anonymous Forms
features.notes: Basic public-link and duplicate controls exist; a complete Site publication lifecycle has not been characterized.

features.title: Mobile navigation, keyboard toolbar, persistent controls, touch selection and drag, responsive columns, offline cache, queue, reconnect, and recovery
features.notes: Responsive CSS exists. Native touch, virtual-keyboard, and offline behavior is not implemented or live-characterized.

features.title: Keyboard-only operation, focus order and restoration, semantic controls, screen readers, zoom, contrast, reduced motion, and high contrast
features.notes: Some ARIA roles exist, but no automated or manual accessibility conformance claim is made.

features.title: Presence, live cursors, remote updates, ordered acknowledgements, convergence, offline queue, reconnect, rebase, permission revocation, deletion, and recovery states
features.notes: The local baseline has revision conflicts and polling only. This row records the required realtime state machine and does not claim an event transport.

features.title: Preserved Agent link, template creation, session attachment, publish preview, publish approval, and serialization adapters
features.notes: These are product-specific adapters, not behaviors to replace with a Notion-native equivalent. Every delivery phase is blocked by their hard gates.

features.title: Database automations, schedules, buttons, webhooks, OAuth lifecycle, external connections, sync databases, MCP, CLI, Workers, and usage controls
features.notes: This row establishes the adapter and moving-track scope only; no provider contract or live external account parity is claimed.

features.title: AI writing and Q&A, citations, meeting artifacts, Custom and External Agents, tool actions, enterprise search, SAML, SCIM, audit, retention, DLP, and analytics
features.notes: Exact proprietary model wording and stochastic output are excluded from equivalence; capability, authority, tool, citation, provenance, refusal, and error behavior remain in scope.

features.title: Legacy capability migration, reconciliation, flags, canary, pilot, telemetry, support, rollback, restore, moving-release rebaseline, and final acceptance
features.notes: NP-11 is an adoption and final-decision gate, not permission to migrate a live store or claim unfinished phases complete.

features.title: Proprietary source, protected branding, undisclosed internals, and copied assets remain outside the clean-room parity scope
features.notes: Only observable behavior and independently created assets are in scope.

second_brain_hard_gates.title: Second Brain Agent navigation remains available and resolves for the active host
acceptance: The Agent navigation entry remains visible in supported workspace profiles.
The link targets the existing Second Brain Agent service without changing its port or host adaptation contract.

second_brain_hard_gates.title: Second Brain template creation remains available and idempotently usable
acceptance: The template entry point remains visible.
Editor, sidebar, and data-model migrations preserve the established template creation flow.

second_brain_hard_gates.title: Current-page temporary attachment to an Agent session remains non-persistent and explicit
acceptance: A user explicitly selects a session before attachment.
Attachment remains temporary session context and does not silently publish page content.

second_brain_hard_gates.title: Second Brain publishing always presents a Markdown preview before mutation
acceptance: Dirty page and side-peek drafts are safely flushed before preview generation.
No publication mutation occurs until the user approves the rendered preview.

second_brain_hard_gates.title: Approved Second Brain publication keeps its existing endpoint and response workflow
acceptance: Approval invokes the existing publish_second_brain adapter exactly once.
Cancellation, conflict, or preview failure performs no publication.

second_brain_hard_gates.title: Editor and database migrations preserve Second Brain Markdown, file, and relation serialization
acceptance: The preview and committed source serialize the same acknowledged page revision.
Block, database, file, and relation migrations do not silently drop content consumed by Second Brain.
